units.name: orca CLI
units.purpose: The orca command-line tool, which drives a running desktop through runtime RPC and never contacts the cloud services itself.

units.name: cli/handlers
units.purpose: Per-command implementations that turn parsed CLI arguments into runtime RPC calls (for example connector.start) and format results.

units.name: cli/runtime
units.purpose: Client plumbing that locates and connects to the local Orca runtime and recovers from client errors.

units.name: cli/specs
units.purpose: Declarative command and flag specifications (help text, examples) for every orca subcommand.

units.name: @orca-cloud/cloud-database
units.purpose: Shared storage layer for push and connector: SQLite or PostgreSQL access, a leader lock and LISTEN/NOTIFY wakeups.

units.name: @orca-cloud/connector
units.purpose: Experimental service that bridges Slack, Discord and Linear conversations to a signed-in desktop through a long-poll machine API.

units.name: @orca-cloud/connector-contract
units.purpose: Wire contract of the connector's machine side: endpoint paths, hello/poll/ack/event/reply messages and client limits.

units.name: @orca-cloud/postgres-schema
units.purpose: Applies PostgreSQL schema at startup under a schema lock with catalog prechecks, used by the relay and cloud-database.

units.name: @orca-cloud/push
units.purpose: Mobile push gateway that authenticates desktop hosts by their E2EE key, stores phone push registrations and delivers queued notifications via APNs and FCM.

units.name: @orca-cloud/push-contract
units.purpose: Wire contract of the push gateway: host challenge/session, device registration and send messages, limits and the host-proof test vector.

units.name: @orca-cloud/relay
units.purpose: Cloud Run relay that lets phones reach desktop hosts through outbound WebSockets, with a director that places hosts on cells and cells that splice phone and host sockets.

units.name: @orca-cloud/relay-contract
units.purpose: The relay's wire contract: frame schemas, close codes and reasons, host-proof transcript, regions and admission budgets, meant for relay, desktop and phone.

units.name: @orca-cloud/relay-fence-broker
units.purpose: Private IAM-only service that holds the mutation lease and runs the narrow GCE fence/supersede operation against relay cells during migrations.

units.name: desktop main process
units.purpose: The Electron main process: owns windows, OS integration, terminals, agent hooks, remoting and native helpers, and hosts the in-process Orca runtime and its RPC server.

units.name: desktop-main/agent-hooks
units.purpose: Loopback hook HTTP server plus hook installers and the WSL hook relay launcher.

units.name: desktop-main/ai-vault
units.purpose: Indexes and resumes past agent sessions (the AI vault) from local agent history.

units.name: desktop-main/browser
units.purpose: Manages Orca's embedded browser sessions and tabs and bridges them to renderer and runtime.

units.name: desktop-main/claude
units.purpose: Claude Code integration: hook files, agent-view plugin and launch binding for Claude sessions.

units.name: desktop-main/codex
units.purpose: Codex integration, including the Codex app-server client and its capability cache.

units.name: desktop-main/computer
units.purpose: Computer-use providers that drive native GUIs per platform.

units.name: desktop-main/daemon
units.purpose: The long-lived PTY daemon process and its client, so terminals survive app restarts.

units.name: desktop-main/git
units.purpose: Git operations for worktrees and repositories (base refs, branches, status).

units.name: desktop-main/github
units.purpose: GitHub account binding and API access for PRs and issues.

units.name: desktop-main/ipc
units.purpose: Electron ipcMain handlers that implement the channels preload exposes as window.api, plus small helper probes.

units.name: desktop-main/native-chat
units.purpose: Structured native chat sessions with agent CLIs, including install and error handling.

units.name: desktop-main/persistence
units.purpose: Loads, migrates and durably writes the profile store and settings.

units.name: desktop-main/ssh
units.purpose: SSH remoting: connections, config parsing and the framed relay protocol uploaded to remote hosts.

units.name: Orca runtime (RPC host)
units.purpose: The Orca runtime: one service that owns worktrees, terminals, agent sessions and browsers, and serves them to every client as permission-checked JSON RPC methods.

units.name: desktop-runtime/agent-session
units.purpose: Runtime-side records and lifecycle of agent sessions that run in terminals.

units.name: desktop-runtime/browser
units.purpose: Runtime control of embedded and client-hosted browser pages, such as capture and automation.

units.name: desktop-runtime/browser-host
units.purpose: Chooses and grants the host that runs a browser page for a caller.

units.name: desktop-runtime/files
units.purpose: File roots and file access that RPC methods serve, such as chat scratch files.

units.name: desktop-runtime/mobile-cloud-relay
units.purpose: Desktop side of the relay: mints relay tokens, asks the director for a cell, keeps the host control socket, region selection and pairing authorization.

units.name: desktop-runtime/orchestration
units.purpose: Agent-to-agent orchestration: messages, tasks and caller identity behind the orchestration.* methods.

units.name: desktop-runtime/rpc
units.purpose: The RPC core: the method registry and dispatcher, the permission scopes, and the socket, WebSocket, relay and E2EE transports.

units.name: desktop-runtime/runtime-rpc
units.purpose: The OrcaRuntimeRpcServer class chain: token admission, pairing, device keys, WebSocket dispatch, the mobile method routing table and shutdown.

units.name: desktop-runtime/session-tabs
units.purpose: Publishes session tab state (titles, layout) to subscribed clients.

units.name: desktop-runtime/sidebar-inputs
units.purpose: Cached scans that feed sidebar rows to clients.

units.name: desktop-runtime/terminal
units.purpose: Terminal PTY inventory, adoption of orphaned terminals and streaming to subscribers.

units.name: desktop-runtime/workspaces
units.purpose: Resolves known workspace and worktree targets for RPC callers.

units.name: @orca/expo-two-way-audio
units.purpose: Expo native module for simultaneous microphone capture and PCM playback, used for dictation.

units.name: Electron IPC channels
units.purpose: The string-named Electron IPC channels between main and preload.

units.name: mobile app (Expo)
units.purpose: Expo React Native app that remotely drives a paired Orca desktop's runtime over E2EE RPC, directly or through the cloud relay.

units.name: mobile/components
units.purpose: Shared React Native UI components such as host cards, PR sidebar and account usage.

units.name: mobile/files
units.purpose: File explorer panel that browses and previews a worktree's files over RPC.

units.name: mobile/host-screen
units.purpose: Per-host screen listing workspaces and worktrees with their actions.

units.name: mobile/mobile-web-shell
units.purpose: Native-side host for the OTA web bundle: mounts the web shell view and runs the postMessage bridge.

units.name: mobile/platform
units.purpose: Platform adapters (clipboard, PDF view, dictation and audio device) with web fallbacks.

units.name: mobile/session
units.purpose: Session views for a worktree: terminal and browser tabs and native agent chat.

units.name: mobile/source-control
units.purpose: Branch diff and source-control views backed by the desktop's git RPC.

units.name: mobile/tasks
units.purpose: Tasks surface showing agent work and its connection state.

units.name: mobile/terminal
units.purpose: Terminal rendering in a WebView fed by terminal subscription streams.

units.name: mobile/transport
units.purpose: Pairing, direct and relay WebSocket clients, E2EE channels, typed RPC operations and per-host connection supervision.

units.name: mobile/worktree
units.purpose: Worktree and agent row display models.

units.name: orca-gzip-utf8-codec
units.purpose: Native gunzip and strict UTF-8 decoding for E2EE payloads and web-bundle ranges.

units.name: orca-mobile-web-shell
units.purpose: Native WKWebView/Android view that hosts the OTA web bundle, plus a native PDF presenter.

units.name: orca-notification-dismissal
units.purpose: iOS AppDelegate hook and module that remove delivered notifications on silent dismiss pushes.

units.name: orca-window-controls-inset
units.purpose: iOS AppDelegate hook that adds iPadOS 26 window-controls insets to the root view.

units.name: desktop renderer UI
units.purpose: The React UI of Orca, shared by the Electron desktop window and the paired browser client, that reaches the system only through window.api.

units.name: renderer/app-shell
units.purpose: Root shell components and app-wide services such as workspace sync gating, command handlers and session persistence.

units.name: renderer/components
units.purpose: The UI components for sidebars, terminal, editor and browser panes, chat, settings and dialogs.

units.name: renderer/hooks
units.purpose: React hooks that bridge main-process push events and agent or automation status into the store.

units.name: renderer/lib
units.purpose: Framework-free renderer helpers such as pane management, session-host persistence, themes, keyboard routing and diagnostics.

units.name: renderer/runtime
units.purpose: Typed clients that send named runtime RPC calls to the local runtime or to a paired remote host, and keep host mirrors in sync.

units.name: renderer/ssh
units.purpose: UI logic for SSH targets: connect timeouts, failure toasts, recoverability and the user-facing copy.

units.name: renderer/store
units.purpose: The single Zustand app store, composed from about 40 domain slices, that holds all renderer state.

units.name: renderer/web
units.purpose: The browser-client entry, with pairing UI, the E2EE WebSocket runtime client and the web substitute for window.api.

units.name: Orca runtime RPC methods
units.purpose: The external RPC method surface (method name, zod params, permission) that the CLI, mobile app and renderer call.

units.name: shared/rpc-contract
units.purpose: Zod param schemas for RPC methods and the generated name-to-params catalog, shared by host and clients.

units.name: ORCA_AGENT_HOOK_* PTY env vars
units.responsibility: Env vars main injects into every terminal so hook processes know where and how to report.

units.name: agent hook loopback HTTP endpoint
units.responsibility: The wire contract agents and the Windows native hook use to post status events to the desktop.

units.name: desktop cloud service origins
units.responsibility: Names the deployed cloud hostnames the desktop dials, overridable by env (loopback http only in unpackaged builds).

units.name: computer-use script runtime protocol (runtime.py / runtime.ps1)
units.signature: one-shot: JSON request file path as argv[1]; Windows serve: -Serve, one JSON response per stdout line
units.responsibility: How main asks the Linux Python and Windows PowerShell computer-use scripts to act and reads their JSON replies.

units.name: macOS computer-use agent socket protocol
units.signature: argv --agent <socket> --token-file <path>; newline JSON {id, method: handshake|listApps|click|typeText|...} -> {id, ok, result|error}
units.responsibility: Request/response protocol between main and the Orca Computer Use.app helper over a Unix socket.

units.name: mobile E2EE WebSocket handshake
units.signature: e2ee_hello{v:2|publicKeyB64} -> e2ee_ready -> sealed e2ee_auth{deviceToken} -> e2ee_authenticated; close 4001
units.responsibility: Sets up a NaCl-box encrypted channel and authenticates a paired device by its token before any RPC is decrypted and dispatched.

units.name: paired E2EE v2 handshake
units.signature: e2ee_hello {v:2, clientPublicKeyB64, clientNonceB64, capabilities, context} -> e2ee_ready {v:2, desktopPublicKeyB64, ...} | e2ee_error
units.responsibility: End-to-end key agreement between phone and desktop runtime, the same on the direct and relay paths.

units.name: orca://pair QR pairing URL
units.responsibility: Carries the desktop's endpoints, public key, device token and optional relay invite to the phone at pairing time.

units.name: phone-to-relay connect frames
units.signature: wss /v1/connect/{relayHostId}; relay-auth {v:1, mode:'connect', credential} -> relay-hello {ok, credentialKind, leaseExpiresAt} | {ok:false, code 4xxx}
units.responsibility: Phone-side copy of the outer relay handshake that admits a phone socket before E2EE starts.

units.name: mobile RPC method routes / allowlist
units.responsibility: The one list of method names a phone may call, which also decides how each is routed to the local or a remote host.

units.name: mobileWeb.bundle.* RPC methods
units.responsibility: Lets the phone download the desktop-shipped web build of the mobile UI over authenticated RPC.

units.name: OrcaNotificationDismissal native module
units.responsibility: iOS native ledger that removes delivered notifications on silent dismiss pushes and answers JS dismissal queries.

units.name: push notification orca data block
units.signature: orca: {kind?: alert|dismiss, hostFingerprint, notificationId?, notificationSeq, notificationEpoch, paneKey?, worktreeId?, executionHost?}
units.responsibility: Custom data the push gateway attaches to APNs/FCM pushes so the phone can route taps and dismiss stale alerts.

units.name: window.__ORCA_WEB_CLIENT__
units.responsibility: Global flag that tells shared renderer code it runs as the browser client, not inside Electron.

units.name: orca://pair pairing offer
units.responsibility: Carries the endpoints and key material a phone or CLI needs to pair with a runtime, via QR code, paste or deep link.

units.name: push gateway HTTP API
units.responsibility: Lets a desktop host authenticate with its E2EE key, register phone push tokens and request APNs/FCM sends.

units.name: relay admin routes
units.signature: /v1/admin/* (drain, cell-fence-attempt-*, migration-supersede-cell, ...), Google ID token per service account
units.responsibility: Operator and automation surface for drains, fencing, migrations and status, authorized per service-account identity.

units.name: ORCA-RELAY framed stdio protocol
units.signature: sentinel 'ORCA-RELAY v0.1.0 READY\n', then length-headed frames carrying JSON-RPC
units.responsibility: Stdio wire format between main and the relay programs it runs inside WSL (and over SSH).

units.name: host control WebSocket
units.signature: wss /v1/host/control; frames host-challenge, host-hello, host-hello-ack, conn-open, drain, ping, invite-created, device-revoked, control-error; header x-orca-host-capabilities
units.responsibility: Carries the desktop host's long-lived control session: host proof, notice of waiting phones, drains and device credential events.

units.name: host data WebSocket
units.responsibility: Per-phone-connection socket the desktop dials after conn-open; the cell splices it to the phone socket.

units.name: relay host control/data sockets and director HTTP
units.signature: POST /v1/assign, GET /v1/regions, WS /v1/host/control (host-hello, host-challenge, conn-open, ping, drain), WS /v1/host/data/:connId
units.responsibility: The endpoints and control frames a desktop host uses to register with a relay cell and accept phone connections.

units.name: phone connect WebSocket
units.signature: wss /v1/connect/<relayHostId>; frames relay-hello, relay-moved; close codes 4401/4404/4409/4429/4503
units.responsibility: Socket the phone opens to reach a host; answered with relay-hello and then spliced to the host's data leg.

units.name: relay token issuer and JWKS
units.signature: ORCA_RELAY_AUTH_ISSUER, ORCA_RELAY_JWKS_URL; Bearer JWT minted at /v1/desktop/auth/relay-token
units.responsibility: Binds the relay's token verification to the Orca Cloud auth service that mints the desktop's relay tokens.

units.name: generated RPC params catalog
units.responsibility: A generated map from each method name to its param schema type, shared by the host type-parity check and the mobile client.

units.name: runtimeEnvironments:statusChanged
units.responsibility: Pushes paired-host connection status snapshots from main to every renderer window.

units.name: Electron IPC runtime:call
units.responsibility: Lets the desktop renderer call runtime RPC methods in-process without a socket or token.

units.name: orca-runtime.json
units.responsibility: Tells local clients where the runtime socket is and which per-launch bearer token to send.

units.name: local runtime socket (NDJSON over Unix socket / named pipe)
units.responsibility: Frames one JSON request and its reply per line on the local socket, with keepalive frames during long polls.

evidence.quote: Local Unix socket/named pipe RPC: NDJSON, 1-MB frames, 32 connections

units.name: runtime:subscription:<id> push channel
units.signature: runtime:subscribe {subscriptionId, method, params} -> runtime:subscription:<id> RuntimeRpcResponse frames; runtime:unsubscribe
units.responsibility: Streams runtime RPC subscription frames from main to the desktop renderer on a per-subscription IPC channel.

units.name: desktop copy of connector contract
units.responsibility: Hand-kept copy of the connector machine-side wire contract used by the desktop connector client.

evidence.quote: // Mirror of cloud/packages/connector-contract/src for the machine side of the Orca Cloud connector.

units.name: desktop/phone copy of push contract
units.responsibility: Hand-kept copy of push-contract enums and registration shapes shared by the desktop push client and the phone.

evidence.quote: // Keep strings aligned across desktop, gateway and phone: cloud/packages/push-contract/src.

units.name: desktop/phone copy of relay wire shapes
units.responsibility: Hand-kept copy of relay-contract close codes, close reasons and phone hello frames used by the desktop and the phone.

units.name: ExpoTwoWayAudio native module
units.signature: Name("ExpoTwoWayAudio"): initialize, toggleRecording, playPCMData, ...; events onMicrophoneData, onInputVolumeLevelData, ...
units.responsibility: Native microphone capture and PCM playback for dictation, the same shape on iOS and Android.

units.name: paired web client bundle
units.responsibility: The browser build of the renderer, projected from the desktop renderer output and served by the host's runtime RPC server.

units.name: orca-client=web upgrade query
units.responsibility: Marks a WebSocket upgrade as coming from the browser client so hosts can tell it apart from React Native clients.

units.name: web paired environment in localStorage
units.responsibility: Remembers the browser client's paired Orca host (endpoint and credentials) across page loads.

units.name: web window.api shim
units.responsibility: Replaces the Electron preload bridge in the browser build with a PreloadApi whose methods are runtime RPC calls to a paired host.

units.name: paired web client E2EE runtime WebSocket
units.signature: WebSocket ?orca-client=web; e2ee_hello / e2ee_ready / e2ee_auth / e2ee_authenticated, then sealed JSON RPC frames
units.responsibility: Carries runtime RPC requests and streams between a browser client and an Orca host over an end-to-end encrypted channel.

units.name: OrcaMobileWebShell native view
units.signature: View props generationDirectory, sessionId, bridgeEnabled; events onLoadState, onBridgeMessage, onExternalNavigation; postBridgeMessage, presentPdf
units.responsibility: Native WKWebView/Android web view that hosts the OTA web bundle and relays bridge messages to JS.

units.name: persisted workspace session (per host)
units.responsibility: Stores the renderer-owned workspace layout and tabs per host partition so they survive restarts.
